compact_alternative.meaning: the same vector in every native cell, independently specified at every host time node

limitations: Prescribed instantaneous real laboratory-frame electric field, not a potential/Maxwell or charge-conservation solve.
Topology-interpolated whole-cell conductivity; no temperature feedback, phasors, moving fields or nonmatching-grid mapping.
Nonzero solid, void and contrast power coefficients must lie in the finite normal floating-point range; subnormal coefficients are refused, not treated as zero.

study_template_text.label: Configure prescribed electrical heating (zero-load starter)
study_template_text.description: Enter conductivities in S/m and one field vector in V/m per time node, uniform across cells. A full [time,cell,3] array can replace the compact declaration for spatial variation. Initial values produce zero heating. No electrical field equation is solved. Authored heat must exclude this contribution.
